tasks.description: In doc/user/content/self-managed-deployments/upgrading/_index.md, add a note in the rollout/upgrade section explaining that if you cancel an in-progress rollout by reverting only `spec.requestRollout` without also reverting `spec.environmentdImageRef`, the spec image stays ahead of the running environmentd; balancerd and console continue tracking the last completed rollout's image (status.lastCompletedRolloutEnvironmentdImageRef) so they stay aligned with the running environmentd. Advise reverting `environmentdImageRef` too if you want the spec to reflect the running version.
